summary: Summarizes experience with the Jabber scribe role at IETF meetings, in which volunteers relay discussion between the meeting room and a text chat room, and offers suggestions for doing it well. It is now historic.

eli5.summary: At a meeting, a helper types what is said into a chat so people who are not in the room can follow. This gives tips for doing that job.

questions: what does a jabber scribe do at ietf meetings
